globalDecisions: GD1 Integration model (decides C2-G2): all nine packages are integrated, built and deployed together by the owner from their machine; nothing is live before that. Ordering only has to be consistent at the end: the /api/auth 404 (P1) ships in the same integration as the static, non-redirecting lab page (P2), and the anonymous Playwright default (P1) ships with every rewritten spec (P2, P3, P4, P5, P6, P7, P8). P0 lands first; P1-P8 depend only on P0 and can run in parallel.

GD2 Per-package verification (decides C2-G3 and transient cross-package failures): a package verifies only its own work. That means its listed tests, the unchanged regression tests named in its acceptance, `npx tsc --noEmit` with no errors reported in files it owns, and `npm run lint`. Failures in files owned by another package are expected until integration. Report them; never fix them by editing that package's files. Every test file that changes appears in exactly one package's files list. Unchanged regression tests are not edited.

GD3 Agent rules: never run git add/commit/stash/checkout/reset/restore, npm run generate:*, next build, next dev, cf:* scripts, Playwright or any server. Playwright starts next dev, so e2e specs are written and type-checked only (tsc covers tests/**). Keep the code style of surrounding files (quotes, 2-space indent, Tailwind design tokens). Keep visible labels, focus order and focus rings, keyboard operation, contrast, and layouts that work at 390 px. Add no runtime or dev dependencies. Never touch content/curriculum/**, content/flashcards/** or content/interview-questions/**; the only exception is P4 adding card ids to the three A-UVM-1/2/3 decks. A package may read any file but edits only its own.

GD4 Feature flags (decides C1-G3, C2-G1): src/tools/featureFlags.ts reads only NEXT_PUBLIC_FEATURE_FLAG_* variables, each by direct `process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_...` access so Next inlines it. FEATURE_FLAGS_FORCE_ON is removed and is ignored everywhere (code, configs, docs, specs). Two new flags default to false: aiTutor (NEXT_PUBLIC_FEATURE_FLAG_AI_TUTOR) and simulation (NEXT_PUBLIC_FEATURE_FLAG_SIMULATION). The fakeComments flag stays unchanged. The server render, hydration and /api/feature-flags therefore always agree.

GD5 Switches (decides C1-G14): pages and components read switches only through SITE_FEATURES (src/lib/site-features.ts) or ACCOUNTS_ENABLED and SERVER_SYNC_READY (src/lib/persistence/accounts.ts). They never import featureFlags or call isFeatureEnabled directly; featureFlags.ts itself and /api/feature-flags are the exceptions. SITE_FEATURES is frozen as {dashboard:true, review:true, notebook:true, settings:true, accounts:ACCOUNTS_ENABLED, community:isFeatureEnabled('community')&&ACCOUNTS_ENABLED, aiTutor:isFeatureEnabled('aiTutor')&&ACCOUNTS_ENABLED, simulation:isFeatureEnabled('simulation')&&ACCOUNTS_ENABLED, draftPages:isFeatureEnabled('personalization'), assessmentCenter:isFeatureEnabled('tracking')}. ACCOUNTS_ENABLED = isFeatureEnabled('accountUI') and stays false on this deploy. 'tracking' and 'personalization' now mean draft preview only and must stay off in production.

GD6 Vitest flag mocks (decides C2-G4): site-features.ts and accounts.ts compute their values with isFeatureEnabled(), never from the featureFlags object. Every vitest mock of '@/tools/featureFlags' must define both isFeatureEnabled and a featureFlags object that agrees with it (or use importOriginal). Component tests should mock '@/lib/site-features' and '@/lib/persistence/target' rather than the flags module. These mocks are updated by their owners: featureFlags.spec (P0), placement-links.spec (P6), and feature-gating.spec, Navbar.test and KeyboardShortcuts.test (P7).

GD7 Identity seam: with ACCOUNTS_ENABLED false, ClientProviders does not mount SessionProvider and useAuth() returns a module-level constant {user:null, loading:false, signOut: async no-op}. Nothing requests /api/auth/*, and no visible element links to sign-in. Only src/contexts/AuthContext.tsx, src/lib/persistence/target.ts and src/components/providers/SessionProvider.tsx may import 'next-auth/react'; P1 enforces this with an ESLint no-restricted-imports rule. target.ts ('use client') exports three hooks: useAccountSession() returns {status:'disabled'|'loading'|'authenticated'|'unauthenticated', userId:string|null}; usePersistenceTarget() returns {target:'local'|'server', ready:boolean}, with 'server' only when ACCOUNTS_ENABLED && SERVER_SYNC_READY && authenticated; useServerFeature('aiTutor'|'simulation'|'notifications') returns the SITE_FEATURES flag (notifications = accounts) && status==='authenticated'. All three give 'disabled', 'local' or false during SSR and on the first client render, so hydration matches.

GD8 Re-enable safety (decides C1-G4, C1-G5, C1-G6): SERVER_SYNC_READY is the constant false until a POST /api/me/import exists. That route will receive the export bundle on first sign-in, re-validate every entry and re-grade lab evidence marked origin 'browser'. Until then even signed-in learners keep every learner record in the browser, so turning accounts on never hides local progress, and the dashboard always reads local data. Account-only controls need a signed-in session through useServerFeature or useAccountSession: the AI tutor widget, Teach-it-back and notebook AI feedback, the simulation panel, the navbar notification feed and AccountPreferencesPanel. Signed-out visitors keep the local UI. With accounts on and the learner signed out, the navbar account menu offers 'Sign in', linking to /api/auth/signin?callbackUrl=<current path>.

GD9 Auth route (decides C2-G15, C2-G16): /api/auth/[...nextauth] is force-dynamic and imports next-auth and authOptions lazily inside its single GET/POST handler. When isServerPersistenceConfigured() is false: GET .../session returns 200 {} with Cache-Control no-store; POST .../_log returns 204; every other path and method returns 404 {error:'ACCOUNTS_DISABLED'}. The placeholder sign-in page therefore disappears, and a half-configured deploy does not fail on every tab focus. The signature is isServerPersistenceConfigured(env = process.env, accountsEnabled = ACCOUNTS_ENABLED). It requires all of: accountsEnabled; DATABASE_URL; a real provider (GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID plus GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET, or NODE_ENV!=='production' && AUTH_TEST_MODE==='true'); and NEXTAUTH_SECRET or SESSION_SECRET. The /api/me/*, /api/labs/run, /api/simulate, /api/ai/* and /api/reviews routes stay unchanged and keep failing closed with 401. NEXTAUTH_SECRET stays required at build because those routes import src/lib/auth.ts at module load.

GD10 Server-only guard (decides C1-G15): src/server/persistence-gate.ts begins with `import 'server-only'`. Next 14 aliases that module itself, and vitest.config.mts aliases 'server-only' to node_modules/next/dist/compiled/server-only/empty.js. No 'use client' module may import src/server/**, src/lib/auth.ts, src/lib/prisma.ts, src/lib/lab-assets.ts, src/lib/flashcard-decks.ts or src/generated/lab-registry.ts.

GD11a Learner store keys and caps (P0; src/lib/learner-store imports no zod, next-auth, @prisma/client, node:* or src/server/**). Every new key starts with 'sv-uvm-guide:' and is versioned with the envelope {"v":1,"data":...}. The keys are: meta; lab:<labId>@<labVersion> (keyed); flashcards; notebook:<entryId> (keyed, one key per entry); assessments; lessons; activity; and recovered:<originalKey>, a side copy of a corrupt raw value. Legacy keys keep their exact formats: 'curriculumProgress' (bare JSON, legacyRaw), 'svuvm.learningRoute' (bare string, owned by learning-route-state), and 'sv-uvm-guide:exercise:<id>' and 'sv-uvm-guide:exercise-analytics:<id>' (bare JSON, owned by useExerciseProgress). Never read, exported or reset: 'theme' and 'sv-uvm:outline-collapsed'. The same-tab event LEARNER_DATA_CHANGED_EVENT is 'sv-uvm-guide:learner-data-changed'. Caps in characters (decides C1-G7): a lab record holds at most 128 000 per file and 256 000 per lab, with 1 000 000 across all lab records (the lab store enforces this); flashcards 400 000; a notebook entry has a title of at most 200 and a body of at most 8 000, with at most 300 entries and 600 000 in total; lessons 200 000; activity 100 000 (400 days); assessments 50 000; curriculumProgress 200 000. Usage estimates count 2 bytes per UTF-16 unit of key plus value, and StorageStatusNote warns from an estimated 3 MB.

GD11b Learner store record API (P0). defineRecord<T>({key, version, empty, parse, migrations?, legacyRaw?, maxChars, merge}) returns {key, version, empty, read, write, update, clear, subscribe, merge}. defineKeyedRecord<T>({prefix, version, parse, maxChars, merge}) returns {prefix, keyFor, get, set, update, remove, list, subscribe, merge}. WriteOutcome is 'saved' | 'memory-only' | 'too-large' | 'blocked-newer-version' | 'blocked-corrupt' | 'not-in-browser'. Reads: unparseable JSON, or data that fails parse, reads as empty and is logged once, and the raw value is left untouched; an older v migrates and is written back; a newer v reads as empty and its writes are refused. update(fn) re-reads the raw value from storage, ignoring the cache, before applying fn, which makes writes safe across tabs. The first write over a corrupt raw value copies it to recovered:<key>; if that copy fails, the write returns 'blocked-corrupt' and changes nothing. A serialized value over maxChars returns 'too-large' and nothing is written. A quota error keeps the value in a session memory overlay, sets storage status 'full' and returns 'memory-only'. Caching (decides C1-G9): parsed snapshots are cached only while a record has subscribers. The cache is invalidated by the module's own writes, by notifyLearnerStoreChanged(), and by window 'storage' events for that key (key null means every key). With no subscribers, reads go to storage, so tests that seed localStorage directly still work. On the server (no window), get returns null, writes return 'not-in-browser', and there is no memory map and no listeners.

GD12 SSR and React rules: src/lib/learner-store/react.ts ('use client') exports useRecord, useKeyedRecord, useKeyedRecordList, useStorageStatus and useHydrated, all built on useSyncExternalStore. Their server snapshots are the record's empty value, null, [], 'available' and false. The barrel src/lib/learner-store/index.ts re-exports types, keys, time, storage, record and repositories, plus the learnerRecords registry and notifyLearnerStoreChanged. It does not re-export react.ts or backup.ts; import those by path. Client islands never read storage during render and write only from event handlers or effects after mount. Nothing writes storage during SSR or prerender. Server components may import only types, constants and pure helpers from the barrel.

GD13 Data safety (decides C2-G12): writes that replace learner-authored content happen only after a user edit in this session, debounced 600 ms; restoring never writes. That covers lab editor buffers, notebook title and body, and Teach-it-back text. Event writes may run on mount or on an action, always through update(fn) on a fresh read: lesson visits, deck enrollment (only when it changes something), activity, quiz and placement results, step completion and card ratings. Lab autosave changes only fileBuffers, currentStepId and updatedAt, so completions made in another tab survive; another tab's buffers are applied only when this tab has no unsaved edits. Every outcome other than 'saved' is shown to the learner in StorageStatusNote or an inline role=status message. User-authored and imported text (notebook, Teach-it-back, backups) is always rendered as plain text, never as MDX, HTML or through dangerouslySetInnerHTML.

GD14 Backup format and legacy keys (decides C1-G16, C2-G11; backup.ts is owned by P8): the bundle is {format:'sv-uvm-guide/learner-data', schemaVersion:1, exportedAt, records:{[key]:{v,data}}, legacy:{[key]: rawString}, recovered:{[key]: rawString}}. legacy holds the curriculumProgress, svuvm.learningRoute and both exercise prefixes as raw strings. Import treats the file as untrusted: at most 5 MB; JSON.parse inside try; exact format and schemaVersion <= 1; record entries validated with their record's parse; legacy entries validated with the P0 validators (a RouteId string, numeric exercise snapshots, at most 200 analytics events); unknown keys ignored; counts reported per area. 'replace' resets and then writes; 'merge' calls each record's merge(local, incoming). After an import or reset, call notifyLearnerStoreChanged(), then writeSelectedRoute(value|null), which also dispatches the route event, then window.dispatchEvent(new Event(LEARNER_DATA_CHANGED_EVENT)). useExerciseProgress re-reads on that event and on 'storage'. Reset removes only known learner keys, including recovered:* and legacy keys, never 'theme' or the outline key. Export sets meta.lastExportAt. The bundle is also the future /api/me/import payload.

GD15 Shared conventions: lessonPath is the canonical pathname '/curriculum/<Tier>/<Module>/<lesson>', with no trailing slash, query or hash. The lesson page passes it as a prop; widgets use usePathname() and skip writing when it is null. ActivityKind is 'lesson' | 'lab-step' | 'lab-complete' | 'review' | 'quiz' | 'placement' | 'note'. Days are localDayKey(ms), 'YYYY-MM-DD' in the learner's local zone. Changing the clock or time zone can shift a day; that is documented in time.ts. Ids come from crypto.randomUUID(), falling back to Date.now() plus Math.random. Quiz results are keyed `${lessonPath}#${quizId}`, where quizId is an 8-hex FNV-1a hash of the question texts, so a lesson with two quizzes keeps both.

GD16 Flashcards (decides C1-G10, C2-G7, C2-G13): after P4, every card has an explicit id that is unique across decks; alias decks share ids. Learner state is keyed by card id and by canonical deck id, with aliases resolved on the server by getDeckCards. decks[deckId] = {lessons:[{href,title}] (most recent first, at most 3, covering decks used by two lessons), cardIds (the current ids, refreshed whenever a lesson or the review page loads the deck), firstSeenAt, lastSeenAt}. countDueCards counts only states whose id is in decks[state.deckId].cardIds, so removed cards never count. The ratings Again, Hard, Good and Easy map to quality 0, 3, 4 and 5. A card is due when dueAt <= endOfLocalDay(now). src/lib/flashcard-decks.ts keeps its default export and keeps the `export const flashcardDecks ... = {` and `const deckAliases ... = {` declarations (adding `export` is fine) exactly as scripts/check-mdx.mjs parses them.

GD17 Labs on Workers and bundles (decides C2-G9, C2-G10, C2-G14): /practice/lab/[labId]/page.tsx uses generateStaticParams over the available labs, dynamicParams=false and dynamic='error'. It imports no auth, Prisma or redirect code, and uses fs only inside the build-time readLabFilesForBuild. Lab files and solutions travel as props, at most 256 KB per file and 1 MB per lab; anything larger fails the build. Browser policy code takes a narrow LabPolicyInput {id, version, graderId?, steps:[{id, version, completion}], editablePaths} and measures bytes with TextEncoder, never Buffer. Solutions ship in the page payload and are listed after local completion. That is a learning nudge, not access control: the repo is public, and the owner is flagged to sign off. Client islands on lesson, hub and home pages never import the lab registry or the deck registry. Server components pass {labId, version, stepCount, title} to LabProgressBadge and only the lesson's own deck cards to FlashcardWidget.

GD18 Pages (decides C1-G1): hidden by default means notFound(), not linked and not in the sitemap. /resources, /projects and /history render only with SITE_FEATURES.draftPages; /assessment only with assessmentCenter; /notifications only with accounts; /community/** only with community. /learning-strategies gets real content (P5) and stays in PUBLIC_PAGES. /dashboard/coverage and /dashboard/memory-hub are deleted. /dashboard, /dashboard/review, /dashboard/notebook and /settings are static, reachable from navigation and kept out of the sitemap; robots.txt keeps disallowing /dashboard and /settings. The sitemap adds every available /practice/lab/<id>. Adding /quiz/placement to the sitemap is deferred.

GD19 Copy and UX rules: while accounts are off, no visible copy mentions signing in. Learner surfaces say where data lives: 'Saved in this browser' and 'Stored only in this browser'. Browser grading is labelled 'Structural check in your browser: it does not compile or simulate.' No made-up numbers, badges, ranks or mock entries. No window.confirm, alert or prompt: destructive actions use a two-step inline confirm. Status messages use role=status or aria-live=polite, and errors are visible text, not console-only. Every new control has a visible label or an accessible name.

GD20 Pinned UI contracts (no package may change these): the 'Launch Lab' link name and the /practice#labs anchor; the heading 'Reinforce the essentials' with id reinforce-the-essentials; the teach-it-back heading id; inside the flashcards section, the card stays the first element with an explicit role="button" and keeps aria-pressed; the aria-label 'Next card'; the text 'Card N of M'; Restart. On the lab page: 'Check solution', 'Mark step complete & continue', 'Mark lab complete', 'Step completed. Continue when ready.' and 'Lab completed.'. LessonMdxPipeline expects exactly two <section> elements from LessonPractice, so FlashcardWidget and FeynmanPromptWidget must not render <section> elements.

GD21 e2e modes and CI (decides C1-G13, C2-G6). The Playwright default is anonymous: port 3100; AUTH_TEST_MODE='false', AUTH_TEST_TOKEN='' and DATABASE_URL='' set explicitly (CI's global values are overridden, not inherited through ??); every NEXT_PUBLIC_FEATURE_FLAG_* is 'false' unless the caller exported 'true'; SESSION_SECRET is the caller's value or a dummy of at least 32 characters. E2E_ACCOUNTS=true selects accounts mode on port 3101: AUTH_TEST_MODE='true', AUTH_TEST_TOKEN and DATABASE_URL passed through, and NEXT_PUBLIC_FEATURE_FLAG_ACCOUNT_UI='true'. The aiTutor, simulation, community and draft flags turn on only when explicitly exported, so the simulation panel never appears without a queue. tests/fixtures/auth.ts (P0) exports ACCOUNTS_E2E, requireAccountsMode(test) and authenticateTestLearner(page); account-only specs call requireAccountsMode and sign in first. npm scripts (P1): test:e2e:release runs labs, learner-flow, regression-gates, systemverilog-3d-deep-linking, feature-flags, flashcard-review, teach-back-notebook, learner-dashboard, placement-local and settings-data. test:e2e:accounts is `E2E_ACCOUNTS=true playwright test` on account-preferences and navigation. check:prerender is `node scripts/check-prerendered-labs.mjs`, and test:ci runs it after the build. CI gains a 'Run Playwright account-mode flows' step running test:e2e:accounts.

GD22 Account-seam unit coverage (decides C1-G13): CI e2e runs anonymously by default, so every account-era path gets a unit test with a mocked session or target. The tests are: target.ts (P0); the AuthContext session branch, ClientProviders with accounts on, and the nextauth delegate (P1); createAccountLabProgressStore (P2); the AI widget and feedback with useServerFeature mocked true (P5); the placement POST when target is 'server' (P6); NotificationCenter and the Sign in link (P7); and AccountPreferencesPanel GET and PATCH (P8).
GD23 Owner sign-offs (implemented now, reversible): the privacy policy and terms wording (P8), which keeps the existing privacy contact address; and shipping lab solutions in the page payload (P2).

GD24 Deferred, and not blocking the anonymous site: /api/me/import and flipping SERVER_SYNC_READY; /quiz/placement in the sitemap; removing Firebase and the community code; moving the notebook to IndexedDB; 'show solution early'; learner-written flashcards; completion marks in the Sidebar and Breadcrumbs.

GD25 Integration checklist, run by the owner once every package is in: npx vitest --run; npm run type-check; npm run lint; npm run validate:flashcards; node scripts/check-mdx.mjs content/curriculum. Then check df -h and run ANALYZE=true npm run build && npm run bundle:check && npm run check:prerender, which expects 23 /practice/lab/<id> routes plus /dashboard, /dashboard/review, /dashboard/notebook and /settings. Then npm run test:e2e:release, and npm run test:e2e:accounts against a disposable DB. Then smoke-test npm run cf:preview: /practice/lab/basics-1 as HTML and as an RSC navigation; /practice/lab/nope returns 404; /dashboard, /dashboard/review, /dashboard/notebook and /settings return 200; /api/auth/signin returns 404; and no learning page requests /api/auth/* or /api/me/*. Then deploy.

GD26 Lead-found gaps, decided here: L-G1 tests/e2e/visualizations.spec.ts visits /history (P7). L-G2 tests/app/legal-pages.test.tsx pins the legal page frames (P8). L-G3 useExerciseProgress reads storage in its useState initializers (a hydration mismatch) and its analytics grow without bound (P8). L-G4 LessonMdxPipeline's <section> count and regression-gates' [role=button] selector constrain the widgets (GD20; P4 and P5). L-G5 TopicPage imports FlashcardWidget, so its deletion goes to P4. L-G6 the /notifications placeholder copy is stale (P7).
